limitations.note: The counter fix lets the fourth input assert valid_b, but removing the ready_b guard also makes the first accepted input of a group overwrite data_out when ready_b is low, whereas the reference preserves the original add behavior.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of ready_b and only compared data_out while a result was pending, so its passing result did not establish that the patch preserved the original accumulator behavior.
